def parse_block_spoiler(block: 'BlockParser', m: Match[str], state:
    'BlockState') ->int:
    start = m.start()
    end = m.end()
    
    # Get the matched text and process it
    lines = m.group(0).split('\n')
    # Remove the leading '! ' from each line and join
    spoiler_lines = [line[2:] if line.startswith('! ') else line[1:] for line in lines if line.strip()]
    spoiler_content = '\n'.join(spoiler_lines)
    
    # Add the spoiler token to state
    state.append_token({
        'type': 'block_spoiler',
        'children': [{'type': 'paragraph', 'children': [{'type': 'text', 'raw': spoiler_content}]}]
    })
    
    return end
